title_en: For sale 1+1 in OxA residence! BARGAIN PRICE!
description_en: 1+1 apartment, 57 m2, with MORTGAGE in OxA Residence, Fresk. The apartment has a regular square layout that is used to the maximum. The apartment is organized in a bedroom with an optimal surface which has access to the apartment loggia, a toilet with a window, a kitchenette and a living room.
